channel.title: For Better Science
channel.description: By Leonid Schneider, on research integrity, biomedical ethics and academic publishing

item.title: Schneider Shorts 3.07.2026 – With collaboration and determination, we can move innovations from bench to bedside
item.dc:creator: Leonid Schneider
item.description: Schneider Shorts of 3.07.2026 - a Georgian dream in Switzerland, a German professor who overdid his papermilling, a Chinese refugee chased by retractions, a great Italian who discovered Imanitib, and the mystery question of who is protecting a US-Iranian fraudster from retractions?

item.title: Schneider Shorts 26.06.2026 – Net zero roadmap for accelerating papermill transition
item.dc:creator: Leonid Schneider
item.description: Schneider Shorts 26.06.2026 - a German university sponsors papermills, picoparticles and visiting researchers havoc in Poland, British climate warrior loses first paper, plus more retractions for a man who never was to Czechia and for men who don't even exist.

item.title: Rui the Drunk
item.dc:creator: Leonid Schneider
item.description: "we are talking about a dictator that systematically harassed students and other young researchers, created inhumane work conditions, forced them into scientific misconduct, systematically committed financial fraud with research money, and threatened and intimidated anyone that did not play by his rules." - comment about Portugal's most cited researcher

item.title: Schneider Shorts 19.06.2026 – Dinner table conversations
item.dc:creator: Leonid Schneider
item.description: Schneider Shorts 19.06.2026 - how to pass on a fraudster, a sex pest meets his friends in Prague, new episode of "Sleuth and the Proper Channels", with retractions in Portugal, teenagers failing to do their duties, and finally, a British man's dinosaur handbag!

item.title: The Misadventures of Luca and Bart
item.dc:creator: Leonid Schneider
item.description: "this is all very time consuming and damaging. It starts to look like a witch hunt."" - Bart De Strooper

item.title: Schneider Shorts 12.06.2026 – Be humble and admit when we screw up
item.dc:creator: Leonid Schneider
item.description: Schneider Shorts 12.06.2026 - a German fraud fighter by night and quack doctor by day, why journal editors don't like sleuths, Chinese influencer exposes fraud in Nature, retractions for papermillers in Germany and Poland, and finally, lab leaks and their cover-ups

item.title: Burt! This bloke won’t Kaggle!
item.dc:creator: smut.clyde
item.description: "This is unedifying but illustrative on so many levels of how quickly papermills have parasitised the Open Science paradigm and strip-mined all its resources. It also illustrates how quickly the incantatory Worship Words of Machine Learning shut down the critical faculties of reviewers when included in a manuscript, convincing them that its ludicrous claims are merely restatements of what they already know." - Smut Clyde

item.title: Schneider Shorts 5.06.2026 – Thanks for the important work that you do
item.dc:creator: Leonid Schneider
item.description: Schneider Shorts 5.06.2026 - a cancer center in USA loses director, russia gains an Italian, Belgium lucky to have a russian, Spanish star and his lawyer celebrate victory, a British pensioner suffers a retraction, and so does a German professor, and finally, can we really trust vaccines from Wuhan?

item.title: Mind over Antibody
item.dc:creator: Sholto David
item.description: "I considered whether I should email Abcam and ask them to change the name of the ab51243 antibody on their website to reduce confusion, but [...] I will instead continue to watch the carnage, perhaps it has only just started!" - Sholto David

item.title: Schneider Shorts 29.05.2026 – Everything can be achieved with extremely hard work
item.dc:creator: Leonid Schneider
item.description: Schneider Shorts 29.052026 - German universities struggle with papermill prodigies, a Polish rector removed for sexual harassment, American antivax papers removed, Serbian Lieutenant Colonel fights retractions, confusing PubPeer moderation, and finally, how to cure Parkinson's with graphene and cranberries.
